title: The insula, cingulate and medial prefrontal cortex are not required for self-awareness

statements.text: Bilateral destruction of the insula, anterior cingulate and medial prefrontal cortex leaves most aspects of self-awareness intact, so the hypothesis that the insula is essential for self-awareness is untenable.

sources.quote: The results suggest that the insular cortex, ACC and mPFC are not required for most aspects of SA.
